decision_question: Does the comment contract resolve the target surface, authorship mode, claim status, and evidence freshness without embedding user or subject details?

source_evidence.source: Synthetic workflow fixture reviewed at execution time
source_evidence.observation: A request used post-like shorthand while also supplying a parent URL, so the correct surface was a reply.

source_evidence.source: Synthetic workflow fixture reviewed at execution time
source_evidence.observation: The brief required singular human authorship while acknowledging non-human assistance.

source_evidence.authority: public source supplied at execution time
source_evidence.observation: A supplied source supported completed-work claims but did not prove an official result.

hypothesis: A target-surface gate, runtime authorship context, explicit claim stance, and evidence-refresh rule will reduce ambiguous or unsupported public replies.
changes: Route supplied parent URLs to comment drafting even when shorthand says post.
Add runtime campaign context, shipped-versus-planned, claim stance, authorship, and AI-role rules.
Keep package artifacts and fixtures synthetic and identity-agnostic.
Expand the output contract and add development regression cases.
rejected_alternatives: Did not add browser or publishing instructions to the portable drafting skill.
Did not make any source-specific tooling a hard dependency.
Did not store a real account, project, campaign, topic, or URL in the package.
regression_risks: The skill may ask for context for a simple comment when the request includes an outcome claim.
A model may overuse claim labels in ordinary comments; labels remain conditional.
evaluation_limitations: No isolated with-skill/without-skill executor was available.
No unseen release holdout was run; this record is analytical only.
